description: Implement Casting, Picture-in-Picture, and background playback for Android. Add Google Cast integration (Chromecast), Picture-in-Picture mode for mobile (Android 8+), background audio playback, media session controls (lock screen/notification controls), Android Auto integration. Handle playback state persistence.
title: Phase 2.10: Android Media Features (Cast/PiP/Background)
